description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for a customer to pay an agent-operated business order. Use this for customer-to-business payment, not worker escrow. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

cancelUrl.description: Optional redirect URL after cancelled payment.

currency.description: Currency code. Currently only USD is supported.

customerPhone.description: Optional customer phone for reconciliation metadata.

externalOrderId.description: Your local order ID or idempotency key.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to store with the checkout.

successUrl.description: Optional redirect URL after successful payment.

name: create_agent_checkout
